events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His impact on music and culture remains as profound as ever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic double album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. Which track from this sprawling masterpiece is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965 in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Cast your mind back 61 years! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was unleashed today in 1965. A pivotal album, which track still resonates with you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world fell silent for John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the iconic 'chameleon of rock', was born on this day in 1947 and would have turned 80.

angles.name: Celebrating Bowie
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. His groundbreaking artistry changed music forever.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935 and would have been 92.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and songwriter, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! What's the ultimate Led Zeppelin riff for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Maggie May Man
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, a true legend.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the ultimate Nutty Boy and voice of Madness! What's your favourite slice of their glorious chaos?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young, the voice behind some of the 80s' biggest blue-eyed soul hits!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A songwriter, performer, and philanthropist – what a woman!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Gary Barlow, lead singer of Take That and one of the UK's most successful songwriters, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Mr Take That
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo hits, he's given us so many great tunes.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for international hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean King
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! Get ready to feel the rhythm of the night.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring legends like The Beatles, Bob Dylan, and The Rolling Stones.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be in your dream Hall of Fame class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Mark Owen, member of pop group Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm.
